draft_statement: Draft core: describe the GPS-like value 4.35 as a composite difference from the reference. It does not classify overall gait as normal or abnormal.
proposed_components: Displayed composite finding; no required claim of clinical normality. Decide whether this adds essential content beyond N02.
selection_basis: Control input supplies no individual walking speed. This proposal can be omitted if redundant with joint findings.

draft_statement: Draft core: identify these leading displayed joint-curve differences: Ankle GVS 6.17 degrees; Hip GVS 4.84 degrees. Choose which joints actually deserve emphasis; ranking is not clinical severity.
evidence:
- AnkleAngles: range of motion 19.7 deg, Gait Variable Score 6.17
- HipAngles: range of motion 46.7 deg, Gait Variable Score 4.84
proposed_components: Named joint findings selected by the expert. No unseen waveform direction or phase is required.
selection_basis: Two largest displayed GVS values, including ties at the cutoff; not an automatic importance rule.

draft_statement: Draft core: describe Rectus femoris (RF) as above the phase-specific reference mean at about 90% of the analysis cycle, with displayed max |z| 2.3. Decide whether it merits inclusion or replace it with a more relevant input-supported finding.
evidence: - RF: above-threshold interval(s) 62%-66%; 86%-48% (wraps cycle boundary), 65% of cycle above threshold, above threshold across cycle boundary, peak normalized amplitude 0.66, max |z| vs healthy reference: 2.3 (above reference, at 90% of cycle)
proposed_components: Muscle AND mean-relative direction AND approximate cycle location; magnitude provides descriptive context, not a diagnostic threshold.
selection_basis: One of two largest displayed max-|z| values; alphabetical tie-break only selects a review candidate. No uniqueness or exact rank is required.

draft_statement: Optional candidate for a core finding: Erector spinae (ERS) has 100% displayed above-threshold coverage. Select this only if the envelope-extent finding adds useful case-specific content; otherwise omit it. Use the retained intervals in the input if helpful.
evidence: - ERS: above-threshold interval(s) 0%-100%, 100% of cycle above threshold, above threshold across cycle boundary, peak normalized amplitude 0.59, max |z| vs healthy reference: 1.6 (above reference, at 9% of cycle)
proposed_components: If retained, describe measured above-threshold extent. Do not equate rounded coverage with continuous physiological activation or absence of brief threshold gaps.
